card.name: Punctuation next to Arabic-script text
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small joining marks (comma, colon, parenthesis, 'for') right before or after Arabic, Urdu or Persian script, usually in translation lists or in pages about Islamic and Middle Eastern topics.

modes.label: Translation lists
modes.description: A comma or similar mark between language entries in a dictionary-style list with Arabic or Urdu script.

modes.label: Intro to Arabic/Persian text
modes.description: A colon or opening bracket just before a native-script name or quotation in Islamic or Iranian content.

card.writes: It pushes Arabic-script words (such as words for interest, water, planning) and suppresses Cyrillic, Thai and Chinese pieces.
card.plain: It marks the spot where Arabic or Urdu script is about to appear or has just appeared, mostly in translation lists.
